headline: As of 2026-10-30: 46,540,473 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+9.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 46,540,473 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+9.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (6,644,285), California (4,780,401), Florida (4,281,721).
